name: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited

facts.business: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) is a Government of India enterprise engaged in financing renewable energy projects such as wind, solar, hydro, ethanol, and waste-to-energy.

auditor.name: M/s Shiv & Associates, Chartered Accountants and M/s Rao & Emmar, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Use of independent agency ECL report for loan assets under Ind AS 109; prior year audit conducted by M/s Shiv & Associates

key_risks: Concentration of advances to top 20 borrowers (43.29% of total advances)
Rising gross NPAs (Rs 3,245.46 crore as of March 31, 2026)
Dependence on external agency for Expected Credit Loss (ECL) estimation
Exposure to co-lending/consortium financing arrangements (Rs 19,682.45 crore total quantum)
facts.related_party_note: Co-lending arrangements with PFC, IFC, IDFC, Axis Bank, IIFCL, UBI, HDFC, BoI, Bank of Maharashtra etc. Total quantum Rs 19,682.45 crore including IREDA's share of Rs 11,040.90 crore.
